headline: Linux Mint 27 release approaches with new features
summary: Linux Mint 27, skipping ahead in numbering from version 24, is expected soon — ZDNet says next month and The Register says before Christmas — bringing stable Wayland display support following the autumn release of the Cinnamon 6.8 desktop.

claims.statement: ZDNet reports Linux Mint 27 is expected to arrive next month.
The Register reports Mint 27 is expected to land before Christmas.
Mint 27 skips ahead from version 24 in its numbering.
The release brings stable Wayland display upgrades.
The update follows the autumn release of the Cinnamon 6.8 desktop.

sources.quote: fresh from autumn release of Cinnamon desktop
